options.text: Call the variable part $b$ the whole simplified result.
Combine $3b^{2}$ with $2b^{2}$ to get $5b^{2}$, leave $4b$ as it is, and report $5b^{2} + 4b$.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Only identical variable parts combine: $3b^{2}+2b^{2}=5b^{2}$, while $4b$ stays separate, so $5b^{2}+4b$.

teacher.key_rationale: Like terms share the same variable part including exponents. Renaming the variable part as the whole answer swaps the task. Merging $b^{2}$ with $b$ drops the identical-part rule.
